info.name: Global Relay Archive an event card

items.docs: Archives an event card to the Global Relay Archive. Events are structured as cards containing one or more sections, each with individual events. Each request must include a unique requestId (UUID). File attachments must be uploaded via the /files endpoint before being referenced here.

info.name: Global Relay Upload a file attachment for an event

items.docs: Uploads a file attachment to be referenced in an event archive request. Files must be uploaded before they are referenced in an /events request.
